How Mobilewalla identified top university talent with minimal bandwidth drain
Hackathon
The dashboard gave us good visibility which helped the technical leads keep track of participation.
Ipshita Dutta
Manager – Campaign Business Intelligence & Product Management Mobilewalla
About Mobilewalla
Mobilewalla is a global leader in consumer intelligence solutions based out of Atlanta, New York, Singapore, UK, Australia, and India. Using proprietary data science and cutting edge machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques, Mobilewalla helps organizations make more informed business decisions and effectively acquire, understand, and retain their most valuable customers.
The challenge
Mobilewalla had a need to identify and screen talented students from various engineering colleges across India. This presented logistical and budgetary commitments, so Mobilewalla was on the lookout for a solution that would help them easily identify top students from tier-1 Indian colleges while not having to travel or invest too much bandwidth.
Enter: HackerEarth Hiring Challenges
After a look around the market at the available solutions, it was clear that HackerEarth’s Hiring Challenges offered the most effective solution at the best price. Thanks to a community of nearly 6.5 Million developers that included a significant number of candidates from tier-1 Indian colleges, Mobilewalla was able to quickly identify the right talent.
The process
A private challenge was created on the HackerEarth platform and was promoted to students in tier-1 India colleges. The challenge was very much a turnkey solution and helped Mobilewalla drive real impact with little bandwidth drain. Further, Mobilewalla had a clear understanding of how the challenge was progressing.
Here’s a look at the services HackerEarth provided through the challenge:
The Result
Thanks to HackerEarth, Mobilewalla was able to reach out to 100+ candidates from top-tier Indian colleges and interviewed the top 9 candidates after a 2-phase hiring challenge. The Mobilewalla team was able to harness the power of open innovation to build a strong pipeline of potential candidates and also marketed the company to a large developer community.
It was truly a great experience to have organized the Mobilewalla Big Data Challenge 2021 on the HackerEarth platform. They have maintained the timelines as promised and the end-to-end process of the event was completely smooth and streamlined. The platform has helped to simplify our hiring process of interns to a great extent.
Ipshita Dutta,
Manager – Campaign Business Intelligence & Product Management
Mobilewalla
